requirements.title: Canonical contract and readable threat pack
requirements.notes: contract schema, digest, ref, pack reconciliation, binding view; slice fixture contract validates

requirements.title: Approval and lifecycle adapters (revoke, expire, scope-bound approval)
requirements.notes: service-contract subjects and revoke in the one ledger; reviewer re-check; expiry from the contract policy; wrong-scope on an edited contract

requirements.title: Shared consumption and cache invalidation (contractRef, invariantId across stages)
requirements.notes: contractRef and invariantId on candidates, in the report and in the regression artifact; context cache keys not yet extended (jobKeyOf settings still empty)

requirements.title: Useful behaviour with missing intent (contract-gap)
requirements.notes: contract-gap decision; uncovered candidates keep their evidence and reach the report

requirements.title: Context bundles supplied to hunter and refuters
requirements.notes: verified bundles to the hunter (budgeted) and the exact span plus controls to every challenger

requirements.title: Structured qualification evidence
requirements.notes: qualification record with citations validated against the bundle, controls with effectiveness, unresolved, decision and reasons

requirements.title: Refutation as a cited blocker; candidate retention
requirements.notes: refutation-vote/2 blocker with citations and control kind; deterministic, model-only or insufficient-evidence grounding; contested; legacy votes parsed as insufficient evidence

requirements.title: Stage attrition and corrective feedback
requirements.notes: per-candidate history in the hunt; the hunt arm carries contract attrition into the lab run; stageAttrition summed per arm

requirements.title: Eval Lab frozen full run
requirements.notes: run config pins matcherVersion, stability policy, prompt versions; scanner records commit and dirty; frozen protocol binding of lab runs not yet enforced

requirements.title: Per-vulnerability stability
requirements.notes: detection frequency, union and stable recall with Wilson intervals, completion by status over scheduled repetitions, valid-run diagnostic; cancelled attempts recorded

requirements.title: Localized scoring kept; semantic secondary view
requirements.notes: evaluator-only semantic view (eval semantic); localized score unchanged; model proposals are ambiguous; duplicates count once

requirements.title: Real-code population and honest release gates
requirements.notes: machinery exists (importer, gates); no independently adjudicated real-code pilot with semantic references; insufficient-population

requirements.title: Paired workflow arms and economics
requirements.notes: contract arm (hunt adapter with adapter.contract); paired comparison rendered; router refuses synthetic scores; no local model run performed, so the four-arm comparison is unmeasured

requirements.title: Explicit boundary federation reused
requirements.notes: operator root map and authorised list; exact-revision check per repository; gap codes shared with the deployment boundary graph; no fetch, no credentials; resolveCrossRepoBoundaries (deployment exports) still has no CLI caller

requirements.title: Identity and authorization propagation
requirements.notes: signed claim, forwarded header, caller-supplied header and message-field transitions; spoofable forwarded identity and tenant-from-message candidates; untraced uses unresolved; line-level static pattern, not a dataflow proof

requirements.title: Contradictions and controls
requirements.notes: a control only grounds a blocker when the context layer recorded it present on the reaching entry point; environment-scoped control matching across repositories not implemented

requirements.title: Supported determinism boundary
requirements.notes: determinism boundary stated: seed, order, explicit group schedule, repeated delivery, durable store; virtual time not instrumented (unsupported)

requirements.title: Security fault plans
requirements.notes: duplicate delivery, reorder, revocation-between (needs the app's revoking step); dependency timeout/failure, process interruption, disk failure unsupported with reasons

requirements.title: Reference-model and metamorphic checks
requirements.notes: no independent reference model in this work; the business-state assertions are the existing transition rules

requirements.title: Fault testing applied to the harness
requirements.notes: atomic ledger persistence, interrupted write, corrupt file, duplicate transition

requirements.title: Representative application profiles
requirements.notes: profile lifecycle declared for express-postgres and fastapi-postgres; this host: express not installed, fastapi not importable, no PostgreSQL binaries, container images not allowed without an operator fetch policy; no confined runner for a real database exists, so legs are unsupported

requirements.title: Linux oracle backend verified before advertised
requirements.notes: Linux stays unverified for the oracle path; no Linux host or hosted job executed the confinement controls for it in this work

requirements.title: Durable regression artifact
requirements.notes: regression artifact carries contract ref and invariant id; environment manifest helper pins lockfile, migrations, image digest or says why not

requirements.title: Telemetry import reused
requirements.notes: reuses importTraceLines sanitization; build binding matched/mismatched/unknown supplied by the operator

requirements.title: Observation-to-regression workflow
requirements.notes: discrepancy -> proposed contract revision -> regression record gated on approval and replay; sealed-ineligible

requirements.title: Isolated shadow patch comparison
requirements.notes: baseline and patched replayed in separate boundary runs; versioned thresholds; latency objectives not measured

requirements.title: Semantic mutations of the application
requirements.notes: six application and four verifier mutants on the slice; mechanical justifications, no independent review recorded

requirements.title: Independent oracle boundaries
requirements.notes: a patch writing into the oracle namespace is refused
